question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH constructor_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name, SUM(r2.points) as total_points
    FROM races r
    JOIN constructors c ON 1=1
    JOIN results r2 ON r2.race_id = r.race_id AND r2.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name
    HAVING SUM(r2.points) > 0
),
min_points_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM constructor_points
    GROUP BY year
),
min_constructors AS (
    SELECT cp.year, cp.constructor_id, cp.name, cp.total_points, mp.min_points
    FROM constructor_points cp
    JOIN min_points_per_year mp ON cp.year = mp.year AND cp.total_points = mp.min_points
)
SELECT constructor_id, name, COUNT(*) as min_seasons_count
FROM min_constructors
GROUP BY constructor_id, name
ORDER BY min_seasons_count DESC, constructor_id
LIMIT 5

{"sql": "SELECT * FROM (
    WITH constructor_points AS (
        SELECT r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name, SUM(r2.points) as total_points
        FROM races r
        JOIN constructors c ON 1=1
        JOIN results r2 ON r2.race_id = r.race_id AND r2.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
        WHERE r.year >= 2001
        GROUP BY r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name
        HAVING SUM(r2.points) > 0
    ),
    min_points_per_year AS (
        SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
        FROM constructor_points
        GROUP BY year
    ),
    min_constructors AS (
        SELECT cp.year, cp.constructor_id, cp.name, cp.total_points, mp.min_points
        FROM constructor_points cp
        JOIN min_points_per_year mp ON cp.year = mp.year AND cp.total_points = mp.min_points
    )
    SELECT * FROM min_constructors
    WHERE year = 2001
)", "preview_rows": 10}
